title: Movie watching and recognition memory: depth-electrode macro iEEG from Keles et al. 2024 (DANDI 000623)
description: Intracranial EEG recorded from clinical macroelectrode contacts of hybrid Behnke-Fried depth electrodes in 16 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing invasive monitoring. Participants passively watched an 8-minute edited excerpt of Hitchcock's "Bang! You're Dead" and then performed a new/old recognition memory test on 40 movie frames with confidence ratings. Electrodes targeted the amygdala, hippocampus and medial frontal cortex. This is an iEEG-BIDS conversion of the macroelectrode field potentials originally released in NWB format on DANDI (000623).
methods_description: Macro channels were acquired with a Neuralynx ATLAS system at 2000 Hz with a 0.1 Hz hardware high-pass, low-pass filtered at 500 Hz and decimated to 1000 Hz. The NWB LFP_macro series were written unchanged to BrainVision float32 microvolts, with no filtering, resampling or re-referencing. Trials, TTL markers and movie-frame times were mapped to BIDS events with a 10 s pre-roll correction.
